data.name: Brizio
data.gender_notes: Brizio is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Brizio is derived from the Italian word 'briare,' meaning 'to brighten.' This name is a combination of the elements 'br' and 'zio,' which mean 'bright' and 'strong' respectively. In Italian culture, Brizio was a common name for boys in the Middle Ages and Renaissance periods. The name Brizio carries the meaning “Bright, Strong” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Brizio usually hope their child will grow to embody bright, strong and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Brizio total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
